performance.verdict: Zero-spend collapse, not fatigue — 5 overdue milestones now risk the renewal.

findings.text: 3 consecutive zero-spend days (Sep 14–16) killed leads to 0; spend fell to $0 on Sep 16, CPL spiked 1,272% WoW.
5 SOW milestones overdue (Jul 23–Aug 31): phone-match attribution, sync cleanup, dashboard, and renewal scoreboard all undelivered.
GHL shows 0 appointments and 0 won opportunities against 79 created — intake pipeline is not converting, not an ads problem.
GBP actions dropped 63% WoW and show 0 for Sep 14–16, matching the spend blackout — organic signal also collapsed in that window.
Pre-blackout CPL averaged ~$8.60/28d; 3-day prior window (Sep 11–13) had 0 leads on $37.85 spend — efficiency was already softening before zero-spend days.

suggestions.text: Immediately diagnose and restore Meta spend — 3 confirmed zero-spend days are bleeding the August scoreboard dry.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend hit $0 on Sep 14, 15, and 16 — three confirmed zero-spend days that killed all lead volume and pushed CPL up 1,272% week-over-week. Check campaign budget exhaustion, payment method, account flags, or ad disapprovals and restore delivery today. Success check: confirmed non-zero spend and at least 1 lead recorded by Sep 18. This is the single most urgent action before any other optimization.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer — dashboard and scoreboard gaps directly threaten the renewal decision.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are past due (Jul 23–Aug 31): phone-match attribution gap, sync and contact cleanup, live dashboard, and the August scoreboard trusted for renewal. GHL shows 0 appointments and 0 won opportunities against 79 created contacts, meaning the client cannot verify a single new patient from Flow's work. Nacer must assign owners and set hard completion dates by Sep 19. Success check: dashboard live and scoreboard readable by Sep 24 — before the next check-in.

suggestions.text: Watch 3-day CPL after spend restores — pre-blackout Sep 11–13 showed 0 leads on $37.85, suggesting efficiency was softening.
suggestions.monday_update: Before the zero-spend blackout, Sep 11–13 produced 0 leads on $37.85 combined spend, hinting efficiency was already softening beyond the $8.60 28-day CPL baseline. Once spend is restored, monitor the 3-day CPL window closely. If CPL exceeds $15 (nearly 2× the 28d baseline) for three consecutive days after restoration, flag for creative refresh on the BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness campaign. Re-check by Sep 20.
